{{Quote|Panaka to group 5—it looks like it's over. Signal your location if you need medical assistance."|Captain [[Quarsh Panaka/Legends|Quarsh Panaka]]|<ref name="PoN" />}}
'''Group 5''' was a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] operating during the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Second Battle of Theed]]<ref name="PoN" /> in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].<ref name="TNEC" /> Once the battle ended, [[Chief of Security/Legends|Security Chief]] [[Quarsh Panaka/Legends|Quarsh Panaka]] contacted group 5 via [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] and requested the squad's location if they needed medical attention.<ref name="PoN" />

==Behind the scenes==
Group 5 is mentioned in Act III of ''[[Peril on Naboo]]'', an adventure within the [[Wizards of the Coast]] sourcebook, ''[[Secrets of Naboo]]'', published in [[2001]]. The only mention occurs in a dialogue box at the end of the adventure. It is one of four transmissions the players receive when their "comlink suddenly crackles with reports from all the Naboo units," including a transmission from [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] intended for the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]], and a general invitation from [[Boss/Legends|Boss]] [[Rugor Nass/Legends|Rugor Nass]] to the Naboo about a party the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]] are throwing. The adventure does not indicate a reply from the intended recipient of the group 5 message, which may or may not be the players' group.<ref name="PoN" />
